worldcombat.skill.powergem.summary: Gather light into a gemstone focus and fire a long, thin ray that pierces: every enemy along the line is run through in turn, those further away take less, and each impact bursts into crystal shards. The ray travels straight and is stopped by blocks, so cover is its only opening.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.use.0: Name a distant target at long range
worldcombat.skill.powergem.use.1: Pierce several enemies standing in a line
worldcombat.skill.powergem.use.2: Force a foe to hide behind cover before showing itself
worldcombat.skill.powergem.description.0: The ray pierces in a straight line, dealing each enemy it strikes about %1$s special damage.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.description.1: Range %1$s blocks with a %2$s block half-width, fading to %3$s of full power at the far end; a block stops it there.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.growth.0: From level %1$s the ray rises to %2$s over %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.growth.1: From level %1$s the ray rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.preference.fo: On: ray width ×0.6, range +2 blocks and power ×1.15, but wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks - for single-target hits. Off: a thicker column that catches enemies in a row more easily.
worldcombat.skill.powergem.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it fire from further away.
On: when other enemies stand within about 14 degrees behind the target it prefers to fire, piercing one more. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
